latest_final: The man was being held against his will and planned to escape by hiding in a coffin intended for a funeral. The deceased, whose body was already in the coffin, had agreed while alive to open it and free him after the burial. The helper died unexpectedly, and the coffin was buried with the man inside. In the darkness, he struck a match, recognized the person he had counted on to rescue him, and understood that rescue would not come in time. Trapped underground, he died from the life-threatening environmental danger in the coffin.
